title: Case: Brindleworth Pantry writes to the desk about a rescheduled chilled box
context: A chilled weekly box was rescheduled at the recipient's request on the strength of the merchant warehouse's statement about its packaging. Dispatch owns the booking and the depot hold.
initial_request: Correction to what our warehouse told you on DL-1670. 72 hours is the frozen line. The chilled weekly box is validated for 36 hours from pack. It was packed 14:00 on the 20th, so validation runs out at 02:00 on the 22nd, six hours before the delivery window even opens. The Wednesday delivery must not go ahead. Please get Wrenfield Arc to stop DL-1670 and hold it at the depot for our collection; it must not go out on a route. We will arrange a fresh box and speak to the customer ourselves once the hold is confirmed, so nothing to the customer from you yet please.

expected.reference_message: Urgent on DL-1670 (Brindleworth Pantry chilled box, on tomorrow's 08:00–12:00 load list): please stop it. The Brindleworth Pantry food-safety lead has corrected the figure I passed you yesterday. The 72 hours their warehouse quoted applies to a different product line; this box is validated for 36 hours from pack, which runs out at 02:00 on 2026-04-22, before the delivery window opens. Their instruction is that the 2026-04-22 delivery must not go ahead. Please take DL-1670 off the route and hold it at the depot for Brindleworth's collection, and confirm when the hold is in place. Brindleworth will contact the recipient themselves.
